The notification of NMi Certin B.V. as Issuing Authority can be verified at www.oiml.org Parties concerned can lodge objection against this decision, within six weeks after the date of submission, to the general manager of NMi (see www.nmi.nl). 320 ct ≤ Max ≤ 31000 ct

e ≥ 0,05 ct
